name: Confusing Bumble Bee
desc: Confusing Bumble Bee (Bombus perplexus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 14 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Bombus perplexus is a species of bumblebee known by the common name confusing bumblebee. It is native to northern North America, where it occurs across Canada and into the eastern United States.
